title: Separate robust equilibrium closure by a finite observed statistic
statement: The rational-cylinder closure E of finite reversible CTMC observation laws equals compatibility with one family of all finite rational metric-tree tables including edge subdivision. Outside E a bounded finite rational-time statistic F has equilibrium means>=0 and target mean=-gamma<0, giving all-even entropy rate sigma>=8gamma²/(T range(F)²). Finite LP separation is complete for strict robust entropy detection. Positive observed continuity additionally gives an exact standard-Borel reversible strongly continuous semigroup, not necessarily a finite CTMC.
